as_told.title: Disc at S4 with a bullet hole shot from below

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at S-4, a secret site in Nevada, in 1988 and 1989, says one of the craft there, which he calls "the top hat," had a hole in it as if it "was shot you know, with a projectile." He tells Michels this as something he saw himself, and says a movie got it wrong: there was one hole in the rim, not two, with the metal "clearly bent out as if it was shot from the bottom." He also describes another craft he calls the Jell-O mold, and the damage would mean someone, somewhere, had fired on one of these ships.
